beedie-beedie:lever:a6e58ff0-c118-4d25-8.title: Corporate Accountant
beedie-beedie:lever:a6e58ff0-c118-4d25-8.description: At Beedie, we foster talent, encourage innovation, and reward success. We’re always looking for like-minded people to join our team and share our passion for doing the best work of our lives. Our approach is simple: we work hard, we have fun, and we make a difference. And, we’ve been recognized as a top employer provincially and nationally. Our people are the heart and soul of our organization. If you are passionate, hardworking, ambitious, and want to be part of a dynamic and growing company that will take your career forward, join us. The Corporate Accountant supports the integrity and accuracy of the company’s corporate accounting function and financial reporting. This role is responsible for maintaining accounting records for corporate entities and collaborating with the corporate accounting team to produce consolidated reporting. The Corporate Accountant works closely with senior accountants and accounting managers on accounting matters, audit support, and process improvements. This role is well suited for a CPA candidate or recently designated CPA looking to deepen their experience in a multi-entity, real estate-focused organization.
responsibilities: Financial Reporting and Close
Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, and adjustments for corporate entities
Perform month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close as well as consolidation activities in accordance with established timelines
Prepare balance sheet reconciliations, including cash, intercompany, and other key accounts
Maintain the integrity of the general ledger, subledgers, and supporting schedules
Assist with the preparation of management reports and financial statement packages
Audit and Compliance
Assist with the annual audit and interim reviews including the preparation of audit working papers
Assist with GST filings
Ensure compliance with ASPE and internal accounting policies
Analysis and Stakeholder Support
Analyze general ledger activity and investigate variances or unusual trends
Routine reviews of trial balances and other financial information
Collaborate with other finance functions, operations, and internal stakeholders
Support the corporate budgeting and reforecasting processes
Review and approval of invoices related to assigned entities and business units
Maintain supporting schedules for key reporting metrics
Process Improvement
Assist in opportunities to improve accounting processes, documentation, and controls
Assist with system enhancements, reporting improvements, and workflow efficiencies
qualifications: Education and Credentials
Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or related discipline
Active CPA candidate or recently designated CPA or equivalent experience is an asset
Experience
2 to 4 years of progressive accounting experience, preferably in a multi-entity or real estate environment
Exposure to month-end close, account reconciliations, and financial reporting
Experience with real estate accounting software (e.g., Yardi) is an asset
Technical and Professional Skills
Strong understanding of accounting principles under ASPE
Strong fundamentals with Microsoft Excel skills
High attention to detail and strong analytical capabilities
Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines
Clear written and verbal communication skills
Professional judgment, integrity, and respect for confidentiality

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:27.title: Fleet Mechanic
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:27.description: Our client is a premier utility company specializing in rapid response and storm chasing to utility companies and contractors in need of a quick reaction force to repair power outages when they need it most. With a commitment to excellence and innovation, we provide reliable and efficient solutions to help our clients restore power quickly and effectively during emergencies and adverse weather conditions while ensuring operational efficiency and financial sustainability. Our customers are our communities, and when they need us, we are there. We are seeking a skilled and experienced Fleet Mechanic to maintain our fleet maintenance while supporting our rapid response and restoration services. The Fleet Operations Lead Mechanic will play a critical role in the upkept and readiness of our fleet of vehicles, equipment, and assets to ensure optimal performance, safety, and efficiency. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in commercial vehicle maintenance and maintenance schedules.
responsibilities: Fleet Maintenance:
Regularly review preventative maintenance schedules and ensure all vehicles are being maintained according to schedule
Diagnoses minor mechanical and electronic problems, utilizing diagnostic computer when applicable
Addresses all identified maintenance needs in an efficient manner while ensuring compliance with maintenance reporting requirements
Oversees and leads the emergency response maintenance and repairs as needed
Asset Availability & Utilization:
Ensure repairs are efficiently addressed to maintain asset availability for projects, jobs, and emergency responses.
Analyze asset data to identify opportunities for optimization, including right-sizing the fleet, improving asset utilization, and minimizing downtime.
Assist in developing preventive maintenance schedules and programs to extend the lifespan of fleet assets and reduce maintenance costs.
Equipment Safety and Compliance:
Assist in enforcing safety policies and procedures to ensure the safe operation of fleet vehicles and equipment.
Participate in regular safety training and inspections, addressing any safety concerns or violations promptly.
Assist in ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, including vehicle inspections, emissions testing, and driver licensing.
Emergency Response Support:
Assist in deploying fleet assets and personnel rapidly in response to emergencies and power outages.
Assist to ensure the readiness and availability of fleet resources during emergency situations.
Oversees and efficiently utilizes emergency mechanical support to ensure any mechanical opportunities are effectively addressed.
qualifications: Certifications in commercial fleet maintenance, as well as a minimum of 5 years proven fleet maintenance experience.
Strong knowledge of vehicle maintenance schedules, hands-on experience in diesel engine and/or heavy vehicle maintenance, diagnosis, repair, and safety compliance.
Excellent communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
CDL Preferred

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:c2.title: Diesel Technician
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:c2.description: Our client is looking for a Diesel Mechanic, the primary purpose of this position is to provide basic mechanical, repair, maintenance, and other related services to the customers. This person must have a clear understanding of routine and complex truck and trailer repair processes, routine maintenance tasks, shop techniques and practices, parts, materials and the operation, use, and basic repair of basic shop equipment. Performs assigned duties and tasks to meet Company standards and customer satisfaction. This position reports to the Shop Supervisor but may receive work instructions for specific assignments from a lead mechanic or technician. This position impacts the profitability of the Company by working efficiently, not wasting time on the job, not wasting parts and materials, not breaking tools needlessly, and not creating rework.
responsibilities: Assists Mechanics with completing complex mechanical truck and trailer service, maintenance, and repairs, on all makes and models of trucks and trailers, including, but not limited to working with the following mechanical systems: engine, electrical, drive train, tire, steering, suspension, refrigeration units, etc.
Performs vehicle and trailer inspections according to DOT standards and understands what is necessary to bring identified basic deficiencies into compliance.

Performs routine and complex vehicle fluid and filter checks and replacements.  Checks these systems according to manufacturer’s specifications and replaces fluids and filters with appropriate materials and according to company standards.

Conducts routine vehicle and trailer electrical inspections.  Makes routine replacements of fuses, bulbs, batteries, etc.  Makes routine and complex electrical repairs, installations and replacements.
Performs routine and complex troubleshooting, repair and replacement procedures, on all makes and models of trucks and trailers for engine and related systems.
Performs routine and complex troubleshooting, repair and replacement procedures, on all makes and models of trucks and trailers for electrical and related systems.
Performs routine and complex troubleshooting, repair and replacement procedures, on all makes and models of trucks and trailers for wheel, tire, axle and related systems.
Informs Supervisor regarding problems or difficulties encountered during troubleshooting repair or maintenance procedures.  Discusses any problems, complaints, requests, or ideas with the Supervisor.
Assists the Shop Supervisor with training other mechanics working in the shop.

Assists with managing the stock and equipment inventories as assigned to the shop.  Takes and reports physical counts of stock inventory according to schedule established by the Shop Supervisor.  Notifies Shop Supervisor when stock inventories are approaching reorder points.
Notifies Shop Supervisor in a timely manner when non-stock parts are needed on a maintenance job so that the parts can be ordered quickly and not significantly delay the job’s scheduled completion.
Assists with the training of other technical staff as assigned by answering questions and showing by example.
May be required to cover the shop operations in the event of a vacation or absence of the Shop Supervisor.
Completes all necessary paperwork and reports accurately and submits in a timely manner.
Responsible for keeping assigned company tools available and undamaged at all times, which will include Company assigned tablet.

Will be required to utilize shop software on a daily basis which includes: creating jobs, clocking in and out of jobs, accurately entering all parts used on jobs, and entering all notes efficiently and thoroughly.
qualifications: Requires valid current Iowa driver’s license.
Employee must have the ability to drive all types of trucks, including manual transmissions.
Three to five years of experience with diesel truck repair is preferred, but 2 years of experience is required.
Employee must have the ability to consistently present him/herself and the company to the public in a clean, courteous, and professional manner.
Employee must work professionally and be respectful of all other employees of this company.
Employee must be able to lift up to 100 lbs.
Employee must have the ability to write a work order.
All employment is contingent on passing a pre-employment drug test.
Employee understands all employees must submit to random drug/alcohol testing if they are randomly selected throughout the year, at no cost to the employee.
Requires mechanical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to read technical diagrams and manuals.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:f7c.title: Chef Instructor, Pastry (Sur La Table)
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:f7c.team: 162 - CityPlace - Sur La Table, 700 S. Rosemary Ave., Suite #116, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:f7c.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Chef Instructor, Pastry at Sur La Table, you are the in-store expert and advocate for all things baking and pastry arts. You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in pastry techniques, baking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Pastry plays a key role in inspiring a love for baking while driving sales of bakeware, mixers, and decorating tools through hands-on pastry classes and engaging culinary instruction. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Deliver an exceptional in-store culinary experience focused on pastry and baking classes that reflects Sur La Table’s passion for food, teaching, and high standards, while following the provided recipes and game plans to ensure consistency and quality. · Communicate technical concepts and advanced pastry skills in a clear, encouraging, and approachable manner. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. Sales & Business Performance · Drive sales by upholding kitchen standards, encouraging second class sign-ups through strong customer engagement, and promoting retail items used or featured in class. · Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates. · Consistently meet or exceed culinary program goals by delivering exceptional classes that drive customer engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations. · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers. · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time. · Ability to move about the store directing class participants while selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · The capability to accurately perceive and differentiate variations in intensity or quality of flavors or odors, or to identify specific tastes or scents using the tongue or n

jobgether-jobgether:lever:1bf5fb54-edd8-.title: Analyst, HR Ops Security & Apps
jobgether-jobgether:lever:1bf5fb54-edd8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analyst, HR Ops Security & Apps based in United States. This role supports the security, administration, and continuous improvement of HR systems used by employees and HR teams globally. You will help ensure users have appropriate access while maintaining strong data integrity, compliance, and operational controls. The position combines functional security administration, HR application support, business analysis, and project coordination. You will work closely with HR, IT security, application teams, and business stakeholders to translate needs into effective system solutions. The role offers exposure to major HR processes including performance management, compensation, conflicts of interest, and organizational changes. You will also contribute to application releases, process improvements, testing, reporting, and large-scale HR technology initiatives. This is an opportunity for an analytical and detail-oriented HRIS professional to make a meaningful impact in a complex, global environment. Functional security administration: Process user access requests for HR applications, ensuring accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning while maintaining appropriate authorization controls. Access governance and compliance: Conduct quarterly security audits and user access reviews, support compliance with data security policies and SOX requirements, and maintain security-related configurations and end-user authorizations. Security troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve system access and security issues, partnering with users, HR stakeholders, and IT security teams to provide timely solutions. Security role management: Gather and document requirements for new security roles, support impact assessments and testing, and coordinate modifications and enhancements through implementation. Reporting and analytics: Develop and maintain security audit reports and queries, producing accurate analysis for business stakeholders, senior leaders, and auditors. HR process support: Provide functional security support for recurring and high-impact HR processes such as performance management, compensation, conflicts of interest, and executive reorganizations. Application management: Gather and analyze business requirements for new applications and enhancements, translate them into functional design documentation, and coordinate releases and feature priorities. Stakeholder partnership: Serve as a key point of contact for HR and IT teams, providing project updates, gathering feedback, addressing concerns, and explaining systems and processes to business partners. User enablement: Support end users through training, guidance, documentation, and adoption of new application capabilities. Projects and process improvement: Participate in HR technology implementations from requirements and design through testing and deployment, manage security workstream activities, and identify opportunities to improve HR processes and systems. Requirements Education and experience: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Human Resources, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience, with at least 2 years of HRIS-related experience. HR technology: Experience with SAP Human Capital Management (HCM) and/or SAP SuccessFactors talent modules is preferred. Technical proficiency: Intermediate to advanced skills with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio. Security and systems knowledge: Understanding of HR application access management, functional security, user authorization, system testing, data integrity, and security controls. Analytical capability: Strong analytical, critical-thinking, reporting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex information and identify practical solutions. jobgether-jobgether:lever:43bd4acd-2e1a-.title: Senior Software Engineer (Data)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:43bd4acd-2e1a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Data) based in Saudi Arabia. This is an opportunity to join a lean, autonomous engineering team building products that help organizations better understand and optimize cloud data costs. You’ll play a key role in designing and delivering new capabilities across backend systems, data engineering, visualization, and cost-management workflows. The position offers meaningful ownership, with the opportunity to shape technical direction and influence the product roadmap. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers and founding team members in a fast-moving environment where pragmatic decisions and customer impact matter. From data pipelines and transformation models to resilient application components, your work will directly improve the product experience. The role is ideal for a self-directed engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, moving quickly, and owning features from concept through release. You’ll also have the flexibility and autonomy of a distributed team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and sustainable ways of working. Design and build new product capabilities focused on data cost management, including forecasting, anomaly detection, cost allocation, and related workflows. Develop reliable and reusable backend and data-engineering solutions that surface actionable insights for customers. Build data pipelines and transformation models that support new product capabilities and identify opportunities for optimization. Create and improve data visualization features that communicate performance, query timing, efficiency, and other important metrics clearly. Develop resilient, reusable UI components that contribute to a smooth and intuitive product experience. Improve application reliability, scalability, and performance through thoughtful engineering practices and system design. Own features end to end, from identifying problems and shaping requirements through technical design, implementation, testing, and release. Evaluate technical and product tradeoffs to prioritize high-impact solutions and deliver meaningful customer value efficiently. Collaborate closely with engineers and senior stakeholders through clear proposals, documentation, code reviews, testing, and effective communication. Contribute to a culture of pragmatic execution, continuous improvement, and strong engineering quality. Requirements 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with strong expertise in backend development and data engineering. Strong working knowledge of Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, dbt, Dagster, and Snowflake . Solid understanding of system design and the ability to develop scalable, reliable technical solutions. Experience building data pipelines, transformation workflows, backend services, and data-driven product capabilities. Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed environment. Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership, and remain accountable for outcomes from initial concept through delivery. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment when balancing speed, technical depth, and customer impact. Comfortable working in a fast-moving and evolving environment where priorities and requirements may change. Strong collaboration skills and a commitment to readable, maintainable code, clear documentation, and thorough testing. A proactive, curious, and positive approach to engineering, with genuine enthusiasm for solving challenging problems. Familiarity with FinOps, cloud infrastructure cost management, data-warehouse management, or observability is a plus. Previous experience working in an early-stage startup or similarly lean engineering environment is advantageous. Benefits Base salary of up to $180,000 CAD , plus additional compensation op

jobgether-jobgether:lever:80c2436e-727f-.title: PR Lead
jobgether-jobgether:lever:80c2436e-727f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a PR Lead based in Netherlands. This is a senior individual contributor role with ownership of the public relations strategy for an ambitious, fast-growing AI and creator technology business. You’ll shape how the brand, products, technology, and creators are positioned across influential media and cultural conversations. A major focus will be on the U.S. market, making strong relationships with North American journalists essential to success. You’ll combine strategic communications planning with hands-on execution, from developing narratives and pitching stories to preparing executives for media opportunities. The role offers significant influence over brand visibility, credibility, awareness, and global expansion. You’ll work closely with senior leadership, Marketing, Product, and creator-focused teams in a highly dynamic and often ambiguous environment. It’s an exciting opportunity for a well-connected PR professional who knows how to turn emerging trends, products, and cultural moments into compelling stories. Own and execute the overall PR strategy across brand, product, technology, creators, and major company milestones. Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with influential journalists and media contacts, particularly across U.S. technology, entertainment, lifestyle, and creator economy publications. Develop and pitch compelling stories designed to secure impactful coverage in leading media outlets. Identify timely news hooks, cultural trends, emerging conversations, and reactive opportunities that align with the brand and its strategic objectives. Create high-quality communications materials, including press releases, media pitches, talking points, FAQs, briefing documents, and reactive statements. Collaborate closely with Marketing, Product, Creator Partnerships, and senior leadership to identify stories, coordinate announcements, and maximize media opportunities. Serve as a trusted media advisor to executives, founders, and creators, preparing them for interviews, public appearances, and other media engagements. Develop compelling narratives around AI, entertainment, creator technology, and emerging digital experiences. Monitor media coverage, sentiment, reach, and other PR performance indicators, using insights to refine strategy and demonstrate impact. Respond quickly and strategically to breaking news, cultural moments, and opportunities that can increase awareness and credibility. Balance long-term brand building with short-term media opportunities that generate measurable awareness, traffic, and engagement. Contribute to the expansion of the organization's international media presence as it enters new markets. Requirements: 6+ years of professional experience in public relations, communications, or a closely related field, with a strong focus on U.S. media. Established relationships with journalists and editors across consumer technology, entertainment, creator economy, culture, or lifestyle media. Demonstrated ability to secure meaningful coverage in high-profile U.S. publications. Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to create clear, persuasive, compelling, and brand-aligned communications. Strong strategic judgment and a proven ability to identify newsworthy angles, cultural moments, and compelling narratives. Demonstrated track record of delivering measurable PR and media results. Ability to operate as both a strategic communications leader and hands-on PR practitioner, personally writing pitches, developing materials, pursuing stories, and managing relationships. Excellent understanding of the U.S. media landscape and what makes stories relevant to different audiences and publications. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, highly dynamic environment where priorities can shift quickly and ambiguity is part of the role. Strong communication

jobgether-jobgether:lever:908eb7b4-98e7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior iOS Developer based in Netherlands. This is an opportunity to build a next-generation mobile financial product at the intersection of traditional finance and decentralized technology. You’ll take ownership of the iOS experience for an application bringing investing, trading, staking, and digital assets together in one platform. The role combines polished mobile product development with demanding requirements around security, reliability, and real-time financial data. You’ll work extensively with Swift and SwiftUI while integrating secure wallet functionality and transaction signing flows. Close collaboration with backend, product, and design teams will allow you to shape both the technical architecture and user experience. You’ll join a fast-moving remote startup environment where autonomy, technical ownership, and strong communication are highly valued. Take ownership of technical challenges and contribute proactively to the evolution of the mobile product in a fast-paced startup environment. Requirements: 3+ years of professional experience developing iOS applications. Strong hands-on proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI. Solid understanding of iOS security best practices, including Keychain, biometric authentication, and secure data storage. Practical experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with real-time data through WebSockets. Strong understanding of mobile application architecture patterns such as MVVM and Clean Architecture. Experience building production-quality applications with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and maintainability. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced startup environment with changing priorities and a high degree of ownership. Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving technical challenges. Good written and spoken English communication skills. Experience developing fintech, trading, banking, or other financial applications is a strong advantage. Knowledge of blockchain, cryptocurrency, digital wallets, transactions, or DeFi concepts is a plus. Experience publishing and maintaining applications through the Apple App Store is advantageous. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with engineering, product, and design stakeholders in a remote environment. jobgether-jobgether:lever:aaeffcbe-9303-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Governance Analyst based in United States. This fully remote role supports governance activities for a major federal Zero Trust acceleration initiative. You’ll help connect federal cybersecurity guidance and organizational objectives with architecture decisions, maturity findings, implementation priorities, and delivery outcomes. The position combines cybersecurity governance, architecture oversight, compliance, policy analysis, and technical documentation. You’ll work with technical teams, governance bodies, and senior stakeholders to maintain clear traceability and informed decision-making. Your work will help ensure architecture and implementation activities remain aligned with approved standards, priorities, and federal requirements. southparkcommons-cognition-ai:ashbyhq:5f.description: WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS. We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re hiring a Workplace & Engagement Coordinator to support our office and help create a warm, welcoming, and well-run workplace experience. This is a hands-on, people-facing role that blends logistics and operations with hospitality and judgment. No day will look the same, and you’ll wear multiple hats to help keep the office running smoothly as our team grows! WHAT YOU’LL DO Be the face of the office - Greet employees, candidates, and guests with professionalism and warmth - Coordinate with building security to ensure a smooth, secure arrival experience - Support recruiting by welcoming candidates and helping interviews run on time Keep the office moving - Manage incoming and outgoing mail, packages, and deliveries throughout the day - Coordinate and communicate out the ordering of employee meals (lunch, dinner) as needed - Assist office services teams (custodial, culinary, vendors) as needed - Help troubleshoot day-to-day issues and escalate when appropriate Support workplace operations & events - Partner closely with the Employee Experience team on daily needs and employee onboarding processes - Stock and coordinate distribution of office supplies and swag for employees and guests - Coordinate client meetings, interviews, and team offsites for employees across our team - Assist in planning office events and activities to keep morale high Contribute to a great employee experience - Notice what’s working and what isn’t in the office environment - Pitch in during busy moments, events, and high-traffic days - Help create a calm, welcoming, and reliable experience for everyone in the space (and eventually know all employees by first name!) WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - Professional, friendly presence with strong communication skills - Comfortable in a highly visible, customer-facing role - Organized and detail-oriented, with strong follow-through - Able to balance structure with flexibility in a fast-moving environment - Comfortable lifting up to 35 lbs and being on your feet throughout the day - Experience in front desk, office coordination, hospitality, or rapid-growth companies is a plus - Creativity and interest in employee events is also a plus WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS Our office is more than a grouping of desks - it’s a central hub for our team. This role helps shape how employees feel about coming into the office, how candidates experience us during interviews, and how smoothly the workplace functions day to day. You’ll have real ownership, real visibility, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how the office feels and runs. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY Cognition is an equal opportunity employer.
